gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-winky-rough: Winky Rough keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, which gives the sans-serif body a compact, upright look. Winky Rough would hold a long passage in a steady, contemporary rhythm, while Funnel Display stays the spaghetti-like voice above.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-yantramanav: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like lines with its horizontal bars exactly as heavy as its stems, and it commands attention. Yantramanav counters with huddled letters, tall lowercase and open gaps in its rounded forms, which keep the sans-serif text modern.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-familjen-grotesk: Familjen Grotesk reads with a lively, tall lowercase and bowls that stay open on a single side, so the sans-serif text feels animated. Gabarito is the expressive one up top, cut open and distinctive.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-quicksand: Gabarito looks drawn with a single nib, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Quicksand follows with tall, bulb-like bowls and bars of identical thickness, so a slightly larger heading above it feels natural.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-almarai: Loose, expressive, nib-drawn curves. Almarai follows in plain sans, its line width never swelling or tapering and its letters never pinching shut, so Gabarito gets the personality and the text stays out of its way.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-amarna: Distinctive is the word for Gabarito, with its nib-drawn look and terminals cut open so counters flow outward. And Amarna holds a longer stretch of text in contrast-free strokes with unclogged little counters, a clean contemporary read.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-assistant: Gabarito's curves never pinch, as if drawn with one nib. Its open terminals let counters flow outward, which earns its keep when the words are big and brief, while Assistant's mouths stay open in the body.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-biz-udgothic: Expressive Gabarito looks thin-lined but has no thinner parts, its terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. BIZ UDGothic gives the sans-serif body generous openings into each bowl, so a modest size beneath the heading works.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-bpmf-huninn: Gabarito does its best work as the expressive heading, nib-drawn and cut open so counters flow outward. But Bpmf Huninn is the modern text voice, with a single-weight outline feel and generous openings into each bowl.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-cairo: Gabarito has curves as thick as a drawn thread, with terminals cut open so the counters flow outward. Cairo would read in a smooth, modern, professional way over a longer passage, its bowls open and inviting.
